nodes.label: Deploy to Environment Workflow
nodes.rationale: SSH/rsync-style docker compose deployment to development/staging/production; prefers pulling images from Aliyun ACR over ghcr because deploy-host bandwidth to ghcr is unstable (issue #81); writes OPC_BOOTSTRAP_OWNER_* secrets into .env only when configured (issue #122, idempotent first-owner seed); optional reset_postgres wipes the postgres volume; health check polls /openapi.json.
